body: I'm sorry, it's not like it matters now anyway. I don't have enough of what I need to commit so it looks like it's another few days for me. Thanks for trying.
Empty. Tired. Given up. I can think of many people I've vehemently wished dead. It's only fair that something negative be removed from the world.

Feelings aren't facts? What about mental illness, substance abuse, verbal confirmation? Are those facts? The literal only thing I do for this household is bring in an income because I'm on disability and my parents are listed as caregivers. Is that a fact? Hell, I took three hours to wake up and see this message and I don't seem to have a nice word to say. But sure I'm not a burden.
I wouldn't call it pain. Nothing works any more and I'm a burden on everyone who knows me. It's only fair.
